title: lathraea tatrica
intro: Lathraea tatrica, commonly known as the Tatrican or Tatric lathraea, is a species of flowering plant in the family Orobanchaceae, specifically a type of root-parasitic plant that obtains its nutrients by connecting to the roots of other plants. The health benefits of Lathraea tatrica include its potential in treating various diseases due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant involve its ability to reduce inflammation, kill bacteria, and exhibit antioxidant activities. The bioactive constituents of Lathraea tatrica include iridoid glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
